title: Red 344 Winchester hold covariate screen
request: Garrett, #yale-shuttle 2026-10-01 11:39 ET: find covariates for the wait-time spread at 344 Winchester (Red stop 11) to better predict Red arrival times; dedicated Red rider Division/Prospect -> School of Public Health.
scope: Offline component screen. No app, production, watcher or archive changes. Read-only inputs: the nightly production archive /Users/grtwrn/shuttle-archive (selected manifests, SHA-256 verified), Open-Meteo hourly reanalysis for New Haven, Yale FAS/SEAS Fall 2026 standard class meeting times.
extension: Every service day after test_to is scored by the same frozen code as its own fold (kind=extension) and reported separately; it never changes the frozen verdict.

labels.hold: Production cohort (src/calibrator/releaseFit.ts): Red stop_visits at stop 11 with outcome=stopped, how!=gap, closest_m<=75, pinned_at and departed_at present, departed_at>=pinned_at; only the audited restart truncation (#316, pin 1789656325854) excluded. y = departed_at - pinned_at seconds. Outcome available to training at max(departure+120 s, first_moved_at+confirm_sec).
labels.lap: Production own lap: pin minus the bus's latest Winchester departure at least 120 s before pin, valid only with an intervening Union Station (121) departure on the same service day. Supported if 0.65-1.65 x the training median lap (900-7200 s laps).
labels.pickup: Same vehicle's first Division/Prospect (48) arrivals.arrived_at after the Winchester departure, within 20 min and before its next Winchester arrival (production pairing truth).
labels.checkpoints_hold: Remaining hold at ages 0, 60, 180, 300, 480 s after pin, for holds still waiting at that age.
labels.checkpoints_pickup: Time from pin+age to the Division arrival at ages 60, 180, 300, 420 s, for holds still waiting at that age.

baseline: B0 = production form exactly: nine-feature 15-s discrete-time logistic departure hazard (intercept, log1p(t/60), t/600, hinges at 300 and 600 s, centred lap/600, missing-lap flag, 15-minute clock sin/cos), L2 penalty 4 on non-intercept terms, right-censored exposure at 1800 s, exponential tail continuation (web/src/eta/release.ts). Verified before freezing: refit at the documented 2026-09-17 13:14:00.913 ET cutoff gives n=259, 10 dates, reference lap 3210.248 s and the nine coefficients of docs/research/archive/release-integration-data/runtime-fits.json to 4 decimals.
training: One fold per test service day. Training = holds whose outcome was available before 00:00 ET of the test day and pinned within the previous 30 days (production's rolling window; production refits every 6 h, so a daily refit is equally conservative for every arm). Lap reference, departure phase, demand and operator-ETA centring come from that fold's training holds only.
covariates_causal: Every covariate is computed from events observable before pin (60 s availability delay for other buses' anchors, 15 s for co-presence, 120 s for departures) or from a deterministic clock (pin + elapsed t). The focal hold's own departure and future neighbour paths never enter. Weather uses the latest completed Open-Meteo hour (reanalysis; live use would need an observation feed).

arms.W: weather: wet flag (>=0.1 mm in the latest completed hour or the hour before), temperature (T-20)/10
arms.C: class-change clock: within 15 min after a standard class end; within 20 min before a standard class start (evaluated at pin+t)
arms.FS: active fleet: <=2 distinct Red vehicles anchored at any Red stop in the last 20 min (60 s delay)
arms.SH: shift/service entry: first or second Winchester loop of the day; hours since the bus's first Red anchor today /10; another Red bus entered service in the last 30 min; a Red bus seen 20-50 min ago but not in the last 20 min
arms.LL: own hourly slot (dispatcher-intent proxy): previous own Winchester departure snapped to the training 15-min departure-phase grid + 1 h; before-slot flag and remaining slack/600 at pin+t; zero without a supported lap
arms.DM: demand/load proxy: total stand seconds and count of stopped non-regulator stops by this bus since its latest Union departure (centred on training means)
arms.UE: operator (upstream) ETA to Division at pin: clipped deviation from the training median /60, >=900 s flag, missing flag
arms.CP: co-presence: another Red bus pinned and still at Winchester / at Union as of pin-15 s; another bus left Winchester in the last 10 min (replication of a previously weak family)
arms.INT: interactions: lap x 15-min phase (sin, cos), fleet<=2 x phase (sin, cos)
arms.ALL: all of W, C, FS, SH, LL, DM, UE, CP, INT with penalty 4
arms.ALL_R: same columns with penalty 20 on the added terms

support: An added column is used only if it is nonzero in exposure rows of >=20 distinct training holds on >=3 training dates; otherwise it is zeroed for that fold (coefficient exactly 0). Reported per fold.

pickup_arms.P0: production's logged rider-surface (trip/card/ride) prediction to Division for that vehicle in (checkpoint-30 s, checkpoint]; smallest predicted_sec at the latest instant; low/high as the 10/90 band.
pickup_arms.RCAL: recalibration control: P0 point + training residual quantiles (rows from rcal_first_day onward, per age if >=30 rows else pooled).
pickup_arms.H_<arm>: component forecast: arm's remaining-hold quantile grid convolved with the training empirical Winchester-departure->Division drive distribution (assumed independent).

metrics.primary: Mean weighted interval score (7 quantiles: 5,10,25,50,75,90,95) of remaining hold over all (hold, age) checkpoints of lap-supported test holds (production's domain), arm minus B0.
metrics.secondary: log score of the 15-s departure bin; MAE of the median; 10/90 pinball; 80% coverage, below-q10 and above-q90 rates, width; per day, per age; all holds including unsupported; pickup WIS80 vs P0, RCAL and H_B0 on checkpoints where P0 exists; pickup WIS80 of H arms vs H_B0 on all checkpoints.
metrics.uncertainty: Bus-day cluster bootstrap (2000 draws, seed 20261001) of the checkpoint-weighted mean difference; Bonferroni over the 11 candidate arms (99.545% interval) for the decision.

decision.rule: An arm is a 'candidate' (worth a full production-estimator replay, not deployment) only if ALL hold on the frozen test days: Bonferroni CI upper bound of the primary difference < 0; better (mean difference < 0) on at least min_day_fraction of test days with at least min_days days; below-q10 and above-q90 rates each not worse than B0 by more than max_tail_increase; mean log score not worse than B0. Otherwise 'not supported'. Production comparison is reported for every arm; 'beats production' additionally requires the pickup Bonferroni CI vs P0 below 0 on matched checkpoints.

descriptive: Variance decomposition of hold seconds and log(hold+15): Shapley R^2 over covariate groups (LAP, PHASE15, LL, W, C, FS, SH, DM, UE, CP), incremental R^2 over lap+phase, day and bus fixed-effect R^2, and the pin->Division variance split into hold, drive and covariance. In-sample and descriptive only.
seen_before_freeze: Before freezing: dev-period (<= 2026-09-18) outcomes, feature support and a dev smoke run of this code (folds 09-14..09-18). For test days only: hold counts per day, Red visit counts/outcome labels per day (archive inventory), counts of logged production predictions to Division, and hourly weather. No test-period hold duration, residual, pickup outcome or score was computed or printed before the freeze. The interrupted first session (11:47-12:05 ET) had started checking the baseline reproduction; its transcript was cut off and this check was redone on the dev cutoff above.
not_testable: Weekend regime (Red runs weekdays only in the archive). Rain effect has very few wet service hours (one wet test day, 09-28).
multiplicity: 11 candidate arms, one primary metric, Bonferroni. No post-hoc subsets; every secondary breakdown above is reported for every arm.
